moaSummary.value: Inhaled corticosteroid reducing airway inflammation — educational framing for asthma/COPD controller contexts. Materia does not invent puff counts or spacer schedules; confirm against current SA STG/EML and the labelled product.
Antimuscarinic bronchodilator used in selected asthma/COPD pathways (including nebulised contexts) — educational framing only. Materia does not invent puff or nebuliser doses.
Sulfonylurea stimulating insulin release — educational framing only. Hypoglycaemia risk is central counselling; Materia does not invent a dose or renal cut-off.
Multi-channel antiarrhythmic used in selected tachyarrhythmia pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent loading/maintenance doses or monitoring intervals.
Transient AV-nodal blocker used in selected SVT diagnostic/therapeutic contexts — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose or flush technique.
NNRTI antiretroviral — educational framing for legacy/selected ART contexts still reflected in public guidance indexes. Materia does not invent a regimen or lead-in schedule.
HIV protease inhibitor used in selected ART regimens (often boosted) — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose, booster pairing, or interaction list.
Dopamine D2 antagonist antipsychotic — educational framing for selected acute and chronic psychiatry pathways. Materia does not invent a dose or titration.
Atypical antipsychotic reserved for treatment-resistant schizophrenia pathways — educational framing only. Haematological monitoring is essential; Materia does not invent a dose or FBC schedule.
Barbiturate antiepileptic used in selected seizure pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose, level target, or interaction adjustment.
Potassium replacement salt — educational framing only. Concentration and rate errors can be fatal; Materia does not invent an infusion rate or mmol dose.
Vitamin B1 used in deficiency and Wernicke-risk pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose or infusion sequence.
Vitamin B6 used in deficiency and as an isoniazid adjunct in selected TB pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose.
Neuraminidase inhibitor used in selected influenza treatment/prophylaxis pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose, start-window hours, or renal adjustment.
Prostaglandin analogue used in obstetric and selected GI-protection contexts — educational framing only. Indication and route matter; Materia does not invent a dose or regimen.
